papers.title: Repeatability of grasp recognition for robotic hand prosthesis control based on sEMG data
papers.extracted_review: Acquisition hardware, protocol, synchronization and analysis paragraphs. No reproduction of reported classification results.
papers.alignment: Piecewise linear interpolation of timestamps to the highest frequency.

evidence.quote: the 3-axes accelerometer in the device is sampled at 148.148 Hz
interpolating the timestamps with piecewise linear models

limitations: Aligned export rows are not independent native IMU samples.
Sensor placement in two rows does not authenticate our device column ordering.
Article availability does not establish the dataset license.
Public data files were not newly acquired or inspected during this review.

papers.title: ReactEMG: Stable, Low-Latency Intent Detection from sEMG via Masked Modeling
papers.evaluation: Public pretraining followed by ROAM leave-one-subject-out fine-tuning; held-out user excluded from fine-tuning. Not evidence of direct public-pretrain transfer to our device.

transition_metric.maintenance: Every maintenance prediction must match the new intent; one error fails the transition.
transition_metric.scope: Tolerance-based annotation metric; not physical reaction-time measurement.

limitations: Paper observations do not reproduce its model results.
Our native audit covers112 static recordings, not all posture/grasp/movement experiments.
Future-sample lookahead is additional to compute, filtering and device delays.
Paper and code licenses do not establish hosted mixed-data archive terms.

papers.stored_signal_montage: Monopolar columns; bipolar pairs may be constructed separately using channel identity.
limitations: Selected text sections reviewed; figure, supplementary geometry and classification reproduction not completed.
Stored monopolar ring columns are not equivalent to our unverified eight bipolar channels.
Our physical direction, wiring and bipolar subtraction sign remain unverified.

scope: Versioned source-paper acquisition/evaluation evidence; not a model reproduction or own-device validation. Original PDF/HTML stays outside Git.
